name: Wheel of St. Rylan
description: A human-sized or smaller target spins rapidly for 1 minute.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Anger of the Forest
description: The target is filled with rage against the nearest creature that is not a plant. Lasts 1 hour.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Brushwood Sneak
description: Your footsteps are muffled for 8 hours.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Summon Wafers
description: A 5ft cube of bone-dry but nourishing flatbread appears.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Tavernkeeper's Charade
description: A pile of coins or gems doubles in size for 12 hours.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Shadow Jump
description: You teleport 50ft, arriving in a puff of dark smoke.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes
